description: Alphanumeric sender IDs: the brand's name (e.g. ACME) shown instead of a number on texts abroad, on the brand's own Twilio Messaging Service or Telnyx messaging profile. action list (default) | create (senderId: up to 11 letters, digits or spaces with at least one letter; messagingServiceSid on Twilio or messagingProfileId on Telnyx when there are several; Telnyx usFallback: one of the brand's numbers that texts US recipients instead) | delete (id from list) | request_limit (says where a higher sending limit is asked for: the brand's own account has no per-sender cap to raise). Phones in the US and Canada never show a sender ID. create and delete change nothing without confirm:true; show the user the dry run first. Free in Hermoso; the carrier bills the texts. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

id.description: the sender ID's id from action list

usFallback.description: Telnyx: one of the brand's numbers for US recipients

name: manage_sms_sender_ids
title: Alphanumeric SMS sender IDs
